description: This file defines low-level I/O routines for hardware access, including functions for reading and writing 8, 16, and 32-bit values in little-endian and big-endian formats, using inline assembly specific to PowerPC architecture. It includes inline functions for port-mapped I/O operations, memory barriers, and synchronization primitives.

methods.name: uint8_t in_8(const volatile uint8_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit value from a hardware port using inline assembly.

methods.name: void out_8(volatile uint8_t * addr,uint8_t val)
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to a hardware port using inline assembly.

methods.name: uint16_t in_le16(const volatile uint16_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit little-endian value from memory-mapped hardware register.

methods.name: uint16_t in_be16(const volatile uint16_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit big-endian value from memory-mapped hardware register.

methods.name: void out_le16(volatile uint16_t * addr,uint16_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit little-endian value to a hardware register.

methods.name: void out_be16(volatile uint16_t * addr,uint16_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit big-endian value to a hardware register.

methods.name: uint32_t in_le32(const volatile uint32_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit little-endian value from memory-mapped hardware register.

methods.name: uint32_t in_be32(const volatile uint32_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit big-endian value from memory-mapped hardware register.

methods.name: void out_le32(volatile uint32_t * addr,uint32_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit little-endian value to a hardware register.

methods.name: void out_be32(volatile uint32_t * addr,uint32_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit big-endian value to a hardware register.

methods.name: void sync(void)
methods.description: Inserts a CPU pipeline synchronization instruction.

methods.name: void eieio(void)
methods.description: Ensures order of load/store operations (PowerPC-specific instruction).

methods.name: void barrier(void)
methods.description: Defines a compiler and CPU memory barrier using an empty inline assembly statement.
